name: Agent hub
oneLiner: 4 to 6 glass tool tiles pop in around the brand mark, connectors draw into the hub, packets of light flow along them, then an output card drops out under the hub; mode fanout runs it the other way, one prompt out to every tool
say: when the speaker says one agent pulls from all their tools ("it reads my email, my calendar, my docs..."): each tile pops on its word, the output card lands on the result. Fanout: "one prompt and it posts everywhere". layout top keeps it above the speaker's head
